generate: Replace four variable-trip radix-3 loops with one packed vector decode.
Stage one PTQ block in workgroup memory for all positions.
Select row-dispatch versus positions-inner-loop per tensor at the measured crossover.
Fuse FFN gate and up projections so the transformed activation is read once.
Fuse segmented LM-head reduction with top-k selection.
Use backend subgroup reduction instead of the portable shared-memory tree.
ranked_first: Packed vector radix decode: it removes repeated integer control and loads without changing scheduling, tensor layout, or numerical order after dequantization.

implementation.before: For each group of four weights, call ptq1_0_trit four times; each call reloads a radix byte and executes zero to four multiply-and-mask loop iterations.
implementation.after: Load four adjacent radix bytes as one uint, unpack to uvec4, apply one fixed 3^n vector multiply-and-mask, and use an explicit two-byte tail path.

native_measurement.method: Median of five runs. Each run times ten dispatches in one command buffer and divides by ten. The tensor and activation are resident. The guest is compiled from .kotoba with amu --jvm-free and runs through :gpu/compute. Single-dispatch startup timings are excluded.

metal_measurement.classification: Existing legacy Deno WebGPU gate; the native loader does not yet have a Metal arm.
metal_measurement.method: Median submit-to-completion time from five samples after warmup, ten dispatches per sample.

m1_model_projection.classification: Measured component medians accumulated across 48 recurrent, 16 full-attention, and 64 FFN layers. The LM head is scaled from its first 32768 measured rows. This excludes non-matmul operations and is not end-to-end throughput.

reflect.confirmed: PTQ1 was compute-bound by radix extraction despite its very small weight representation; reducing control and repeated loads improved every backend.
reflect.rejected: A hardware-only explanation. The same bytes and dispatch geometry became 1.84 to 2.42 times faster from shader code alone.
carry_forward: Measure and encode the row-dispatch versus positions-inner-loop crossover per tensor.
Add a native Metal loader arm so all four backends use the same measurement path.
Wire the complete Qwen3.8-27B token recipe before making HTTP or end-to-end throughput claims.
